premises.text: College students struggle to find help and resources for studying
premises.evidence_span: it's hard for students to master a topic if they can't get help on demand. It's hard to find study groups.

premises.text: Students can easily access knowledge from their classmates through the platform
premises.evidence_span: any student can easily access the brain power and knowledge of their entire class right on our platform.

premises.text: Collaborative study guides can be created by students for their courses
premises.evidence_span: one of his classmates created in one tap a collaborative study guide for everyone to help by adding their answers.

premises.text: Students can access shared files and resources from classmates for free
premises.evidence_span: students can have access to all the files and resources shared by his classmates completely and absolutely free.

premises.text: One-on-one help is the most effective way for students to learn
premises.evidence_span: we know one-on-one help is hands down the best way of learning.

premises.text: The peer mentor program allows students to offer tutoring sessions and earn money
premises.evidence_span: we're going to allow every single college student to offer online on-demand tutoring sessions and make some money while helping others.

premises.text: The platform can target students' needs for help based on their course information
premises.evidence_span: we know exactly when they need help. We know exactly the subject they need help with.

value.text: Students receive personalized, on-demand help and resources for their studies
value.evidence_span: a way for every single college student to get personalized one-on-one help right when they need it.

notes: Corporate customer count, fundraising, and demo offer are excluded as traction.
